title: Anthropic begins its roadshow for a planned IPO
teaser: Anthropic has begun its roadshow ahead of a planned initial public offering of Class A shares. The company intends to offer 825 million shares: 801,351,354 on its own behalf and another 23,648,646 on behalf of certain current shareholders. Anthropic will not receive proceeds from the sale of shares by shareholders. The expected offering price is $70 to $78 per share. The company also plans to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to 123.75 million additional shares. Anthropic has applied to list on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker ANT.
